grievance_text: There is a large pothole on the road outside my house that has not been repaired for over 8 months despite several complaints to the ward office.
Ever since PWD relaid the road in our colony six months ago, the road floods every time it rains because the new surface has no proper drainage slope.
A road widening project near our market started over a year ago and was never completed; it has been left half-dug and unusable ever since.
The footpath along the main road has broken tiles and exposed rebar in several places, and an elderly neighbour tripped and was injured there last month.
